rows.note: Mario is about 1.6 m tall, close to Commando.
SM64 runs at 30 frames a second; rendering interpolates between ticks.
World collision is cut into square chunks, each one libsm64 surface object.
Chunks loaded on each side of Mario (3 x 3, 96 m). libsm64 tests every loaded triangle on each step, so less is faster; Mario is always 32 m+ from the unloaded edge.
A single hit this big knocks Mario back SM64-style.
Falling this far below the last ground puts Mario back on it.
SM64's own health is kept full; RoR2's health is the real one.
SM64's water and poison gas lines, put far below every stage (libsm64 defaults sit at -100 m, above Golem Plains' floor).
RoR2's stages are hilly: on SM64's default surface Mario slides off anything past 38 degrees and wedges in crevices. Not-slippery ground still lets him slide, slide-kick and butt-slide on purpose.
